final_report_title: 买方收购战略分析报告 / Buyer-side Acquisition Strategy Report
report_goal: Preserve the buyer-side acquisition strategy report framework while strengthening it into decision-grade analysis. The report must answer whether the buyer should proceed at the proposed price, timing, structure, and risk level; strategic rationale alone is not sufficient.
required_report_sections: 3. 买方战略目标 / Buyer Strategic Objectives
4. 标的业务质量 / Target Business Quality
5. 行业与竞争地位 / Industry and Competitive Position
7. 独立财务分析 / Standalone Financial Analysis
8. 估值与可接受收购价格 / Valuation and Acceptable Purchase Price
9. 协同效应与价值创造 / Synergies and Value Creation
11. 融资及资本结构影响 / Financing and Capital Structure Impact
13. 尽职调查发现 / Due Diligence Findings
14. 监管、整合与下行风险 / Regulatory, Integration, and Downside Risks
15. 最终决策建议 / Final Decision Recommendation
conditional_table_library: 买方战略目标与成功标准表
交易条件与退出红线表
适应症级 rNPV 敏感性表
Build / Buy / License / Partner / Wait 对比表
临床 / 监管 / IP / CMC 决策尽调表
table_selection_rule: Tables are selected for decision value and sector relevance. Empty tables, repeated Pending diligence rows, and table-count completeness are not quality evidence.
decision_grade_minimum_requirements: all company, person, product, date, amount, industry, jurisdiction, and case-conclusion content must come from the current mandate, current-case files, or current-case research; prior-case content is forbidden
keep the original buyer-side acquisition strategy report section logic

the agent must evaluate core judgment, evidence base, causal analysis, counter-thesis, assumptions, methods, cross-checks, thresholds, dependencies, confidence, decision impact, and evidence gaps internally before drafting each major section
the agent must select methods from the current case and record model ID, rationale, scenario policy, and supporting basis IDs before calculation
no single sector or valuation model is globally required; replay only applicable supported adapters and fail closed when an essential adapter is unavailable
the agent must prioritize research by decision leverage and compare acquisition with at least one case-relevant alternative; build / license / partner / wait are evaluated where applicable
the agent must run an adversarial quality-control pass before report-content synthesis
the renderer must only serialize validated report content and must not invent business judgments, conditions, diligence actions, or integration workstreams
case_analysis.json is authoritative for report judgments; file-presence and keyword heuristics are forbidden substitutes for completed analysis
later disclosures of historical facts and post-decision hindsight must be separated from information available at the decision date

when current-case evidence identifies a clinical-stage biopharma asset, use indication-level rNPV, PTRS, clinical, regulatory, IP, CMC, market, financing, and milestone analysis; do not apply this adapter to unrelated cases
the main report must synthesize internal analysis objects into natural section-specific acquisition analysis and must not print internal field labels as a repeated template
facts and caveats must be translated into buyer-side decision implications instead of listed as standalone information
explicit proceed / proceed with conditions / renegotiate / defer / walk away recommendation
buyer-specific motivation, not only generic strategic fit
why-now timing analysis
valuation status and price recommendation status
competitive differentiation assessment
deal structure and risk-sharing analysis
synergy value status, quantified where certified and explicitly marked unavailable where not certified
downside case and red lines
100-day integration or development plan only when the transaction stage and current-case evidence make it decision-relevant
clear statement when valuation, comparable deals, or price ceiling are not certified

restricted_output_rules.if_valuation_is_not_certified: Do not present final price fairness, maximum bid, or full approval recommendation. Keep the buyer-side acquisition strategy report structure and mark valuation gaps explicitly.
restricted_output_rules.if_competitive_differentiation_is_not_ce: Do not claim the buyer can win; state the competitive analysis gap and required diligence.
restricted_output_rules.if_final_recommendation_depends_on_human: Use Proceed with Conditions, Defer, or Research Gap Memo Only instead of unrestricted Proceed.
